headline: Alphabet Shares Drop $500 Billion as AI Summaries Threaten Ad Revenue
summary: Alphabet lost $500 billion in market value as the rise of AI-driven search features reduced user engagement with traditional, high-margin Google advertisements.
why: Alphabet is a dominant global technology conglomerate whose core revenue depends heavily on digital advertising. Shifts toward artificial intelligence search interfaces pose structural questions for its monetization model.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc.
impacts.why: Transitioning user queries to AI summaries that display fewer traditional ads creates investor anxiety over near-term advertising revenues and profit margins.

why_moved: Investors rapidly repriced the stock after recognizing that artificial intelligence search tools cannibalize the high-margin ad placements that drive the company's primary earnings stream.
